svg.text: NodeMCU 1.0 (ESP-12E). Power every module from 3V3, never 5V. Check the pin names printed on your own modules: order varies by maker.
Modules have the pull-up resistor built in.
Bare 4-pin sensor: add 10 kΩ from DATA to 3V3.
Reads at most once per second; ±2 °C, 0 to 50 °C.
Must use 3V3: A0 cannot take more than 3.3 V.
